ingredients.name: fennel
ingredients.description: A crisp, pale bulb with a clean anise sweetness that softens to something almost buttery when braised or roasted. Shave it raw into salads with citrus, or cook it slowly under a roast where it drinks up the juices.

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.description: Sweet and sharp at once, the backbone of summer cooking from salads to long-simmered sauces. It wants salt, good oil and a soft herb, and it turns deep and savoury with heat.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.description: The quiet foundation of nearly every savoury dish: sharp and hot raw, sweet and mellow once cooked slowly. Caramelised it becomes a sauce on its own.

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.description: Milder and sweeter than a yellow onion, with a purple colour that brightens as soon as it meets acid. Sliced thin and dressed with lime or vinegar it belongs on salads, salsas and tacos.

ingredients.name: shallot
ingredients.description: A small, fine-grained onion with a delicate sweetness and a hint of garlic. The classic base for French pan sauces and vinaigrettes, and crisped in oil it is a Southeast Asian garnish.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.description: Pungent and hot when raw, sweet and nutty when roasted or confited. It threads through almost every cuisine and works with nearly everything savoury.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.description: The gentlest of the onion family, silky and sweet when braised in butter. It is the heart of vichyssoise and belongs beside potato, cream and fish.

ingredients.name: scallion
ingredients.description: Young onions with a mild, grassy bite and a fresh green top. Essential to Chinese and Japanese cooking as a finishing touch with ginger, soy and sesame.

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.description: Earthy, starchy and endlessly accommodating, from a crisp roast to a silky purée. It carries butter, cream, salt and herbs without complaint.

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.description: Dense, sweet orange flesh that roasts to a caramel edge. Equally at home with maple and pecans or with chile, lime and black beans.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.description: Sweet, earthy and brightly coloured, a cornerstone of stocks and braises. Roasted with cumin and honey it turns into a dish in its own right.

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.description: Crisp, watery and faintly bitter with a clean salinity. It anchors mirepoix and soffritto, and raw it is the natural partner of blue cheese and walnuts.

ingredients.name: beet
ingredients.description: Sweet, earthy and deeply coloured, best roasted whole until the skin slips off. Goat cheese, orange, walnut and horseradish all answer its sweetness.

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.description: Sweet when cooked slowly, peppery when raw, and transformed by fermentation into sauerkraut or kimchi. Pork, caraway and apple are its oldest companions.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.description: A sturdy, mineral green with a pleasant bitterness that softens with garlic and oil. Tuscan cooks braise it with beans; raw it needs lemon and a firm massage.

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.description: Tender leaves that collapse into a dark, mineral tangle in seconds. Cream, nutmeg and cheese flatter it; in India it is cooked down with paneer and spice.

ingredients.name: arugula
ingredients.description: Peppery, slightly bitter leaves that bring heat to a salad. Shaved parmesan, lemon and good olive oil are all it needs.

ingredients.name: radicchio
ingredients.description: A bitter, wine-red chicory that sweetens on the grill. It pairs with balsamic, gorgonzola, pear and walnuts in the Venetian manner.

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.description: Green, grassy and faintly bitter, with florets that catch sauce. Roasted hard with garlic and chile, or stir-fried with ginger and oyster sauce.

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.description: Mild and nutty, a blank canvas that roasts to golden sweetness. Tahini and pomegranate, brown butter and capers, or Indian spice all suit it.

ingredients.name: brussels sprout
ingredients.description: Little cabbages with a nutty, bitter edge that turns sweet when roasted or fried. Bacon, chestnuts and a splash of vinegar are the classic frame.

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.description: The first green of spring, grassy and sweet with a faint bitterness. Butter, egg, parmesan and lemon are the pairings every cook learns first.

ingredients.name: artichoke
ingredients.description: A thistle bud with a nutty, faintly sweet heart under tough leaves. Roman cooks braise it with mint and garlic; it loves lemon and olive oil.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.description: Spongy and mild raw, silky and smoky once roasted or grilled. It carries tahini, miso, tomato and garlic across half the world's cuisines.

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.description: A mild summer squash with sweet, watery flesh. Grilled, fried or shaved raw, it wants basil, mint, lemon and a salty cheese.

ingredients.name: bell pepper
ingredients.description: Sweet and juicy, especially when roasted until the skin blisters. Spanish, Basque and Hungarian cooking build whole dishes around it.

ingredients.name: chile
ingredients.description: Heat in countless forms, from fruity and mild to fierce. It sharpens lime, garlic and cilantro and even deepens chocolate.

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.description: Cool, watery and clean, the most refreshing thing in the kitchen. Yogurt, dill and mint, or rice vinegar and sesame, are its two great directions.

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.description: Earthy, savoury and meaty, the vegetable closest to umami. Butter, garlic, thyme and cream bring out everything it has.

ingredients.name: corn
ingredients.description: Sweet, milky kernels at their best in late summer. Butter and salt are enough; lime, chile and cotija turn it Mexican.

ingredients.name: pea
ingredients.description: Tiny bursts of sweetness that taste of spring. Mint, butter and a little cured pork are the oldest pairings.

ingredients.name: fava bean
ingredients.description: Bright green beans with a sweet, slightly bitter taste, worth the double peeling. Romans eat them raw with pecorino; mint and olive oil follow close behind.

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.description: Slender, snappy and grassy, best cooked briefly. Butter and almonds, or a mustardy vinaigrette with shallots.

ingredients.name: lettuce
ingredients.description: Crisp, watery leaves that carry a dressing. Little gem and romaine stand up to anchovy, parmesan and a good vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: radish
ingredients.description: Crisp and peppery with a wet crunch. The French eat it with butter and salt; sliced thin it brightens tacos and salads.

ingredients.name: squash
ingredients.description: Dense, sweet orange flesh that roasts to a caramel edge. Sage, brown butter and parmesan in Italy; coconut milk and chile in Thailand.

photo.alt: A whole butternut squash on a pale background

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.description: Buttery, mild and rich, a fruit used like a vegetable. Lime, salt and chile are its essential companions.

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.description: Bright, sweet and sharp, with a zest full of aromatic oil. It lifts fennel salads, glazes duck and partners chocolate in every pastry tradition.

ingredients.name: blood orange
ingredients.description: A winter orange with raspberry notes and a deep red flesh. Sicilians serve it with fennel and olives; it is also the soul of a good spritz.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.description: The sharpest tool in the kitchen: sour, fragrant and clean. A squeeze finishes almost anything, and the zest carries the perfume.

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.description: Sharper and more floral than lemon, the acid of Mexico and Southeast Asia. Chile, cilantro and fish sauce are rarely far away.

ingredients.name: grapefruit
ingredients.description: Sour, bitter and a little sweet, a wake-up call of a fruit. Avocado, shrimp and mint balance it; Campari and gin love it.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.description: Crisp, sweet and tart, the orchard fruit of pies, sauces and cheese boards. Pork, cinnamon, caramel and cheddar are the old allies.

ingredients.name: pear
ingredients.description: Soft, sweet and faintly grainy, a quieter cousin of the apple. Blue cheese, walnut, chocolate and red wine bring out its depth.

ingredients.name: fig
ingredients.description: Honeyed, jammy and seedy, at its best eaten warm from the tree. Prosciutto, goat cheese and honey make it a classic starter.

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.description: Sweet or sour, dark and juicy, the fruit of early summer. Almond, chocolate and kirsch are its natural partners; duck loves it too.

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.description: Sweet, fragrant and a little tart. Cream is the obvious partner; basil, balsamic vinegar and black pepper are the surprising ones.

ingredients.name: raspberry
ingredients.description: Tart, perfumed and delicate, with a seedy crunch. Chocolate, cream and lemon frame it in nearly every dessert.

ingredients.name: blueberry
ingredients.description: Mildly sweet with a faint tartness that intensifies in the oven. Lemon, cinnamon and oats are breakfast companions.

ingredients.name: blackberry
ingredients.description: Dark, sweet-sour and a little wild. Apple crumble is its home, and game birds and venison take its sauce.

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.description: Juicy, fragrant and sweet, the fruit of high summer. Burrata, basil and prosciutto for a salad; almond and amaretto for dessert.

ingredients.name: apricot
ingredients.description: Sweet, tart and intensely fragrant, fresh or dried. Lamb tagines, almond tarts and cardamom all suit it.

ingredients.name: mango
ingredients.description: Lush, sweet and tropical, with a resinous edge in the skin. Lime, chile and coconut make it Thai or Mexican; cardamom makes it Indian.

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.description: Juicy, sweet and sharply acidic with a tropical perfume. Pork, rum, coconut and chile answer its sweetness.

ingredients.name: banana
ingredients.description: Soft, sweet and starchy, more fragrant as it ripens. Caramel, chocolate, peanut and rum turn it into dessert.

ingredients.name: pomegranate
ingredients.description: Jewel-like seeds that are sweet, sour and faintly astringent. Walnut, lamb, mint and feta carry it through Persian and Levantine cooking.

ingredients.name: date
ingredients.description: Deeply sweet and chewy with notes of caramel. Almond, tahini, bacon and coffee bring balance.

ingredients.name: cranberry
ingredients.description: Sharp and astringent, needing sugar to come round. Orange and turkey are the classic pairing; it also brightens baked goods.

ingredients.name: rhubarb
ingredients.description: A sour, astringent stalk that cooks down to a tart compote. Strawberry, ginger and custard tame it.

ingredients.name: quince
ingredients.description: Hard and astringent raw, fragrant and rose-coloured once poached. It belongs with manchego, lamb and slow cooking.

ingredients.name: melon
ingredients.description: Sweet, cool and perfumed. Prosciutto, mint, lime and a crack of black pepper are the classic treatments.

ingredients.name: watermelon
ingredients.description: Crisp, sweet and endlessly juicy. Feta, mint and lime make the summer salad; chile and salt make the Mexican snack.

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.description: Sweet, rich and nutty in flesh and milk alike. It carries chile, lime and lemongrass through Thai and South Indian curries.

ingredients.name: passion fruit
ingredients.description: Intensely sour and perfumed, a few seeds go a long way. Mango, white chocolate and meringue soften its edges.

ingredients.name: raisin
ingredients.description: Sweet, chewy dried grapes with notes of caramel. Pine nuts and spinach in Sicily, cinnamon and oats at breakfast.

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.description: Sweet, peppery and faintly clove-like, the herb of summer tomatoes. Torn at the last moment it perfumes pasta, pizza and salads; pounded it becomes pesto.

ingredients.name: mint
ingredients.description: Cool, sweet and bracing. Peas, lamb, cucumber and yogurt in the kitchen; tea and cocktails beyond it.

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.description: Clean, grassy and faintly bitter, the herb that makes other flavours clearer. Lemon and garlic are its constant company.

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.description: Bright, citrusy and divisive, the herb of Mexican, Thai and Indian cooking. Lime and chile are never far away.

ingredients.name: dill
ingredients.description: Feathery and fresh with a sweet, anise-like note. Cucumber, salmon, yogurt and potato are its northern home.

ingredients.name: chives
ingredients.description: A delicate onion flavour in a grassy strand. Eggs, potatoes and sour cream are the classic frame.

ingredients.name: tarragon
ingredients.description: Sweet, anise-scented and distinctly French. Chicken, eggs, shellfish and a béarnaise sauce are where it shines.

ingredients.name: thyme
ingredients.description: Woody, earthy and quietly fragrant, the herb that goes into the pot at the start. Roasts, braises and stocks depend on it.

ingredients.name: rosemary
ingredients.description: Piney, resinous and strong. Lamb, potatoes and bread are the oldest pairings; a little goes far.

photo.alt: A sprig of fresh rosemary against a dark background

ingredients.name: sage
ingredients.description: Musky, savoury and a little bitter, fried in butter until crisp. Squash, pork and gnocchi are its Italian home.

ingredients.name: oregano
ingredients.description: Warm, peppery and slightly bitter, better dried than fresh. Greek grills, tomato sauces and pizza.

ingredients.name: bay leaf
ingredients.description: A subtle, tea-like aromatic that works in the background of stocks, braises and custards. Remove before serving.

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.description: Earthy, warm and faintly bitter, toasted to bring out its oils. Mexican, Indian and Moroccan cooking all lean on it.

ingredients.name: coriander seed
ingredients.description: Citrusy, floral and warm, quite unlike the leaf. Ground into curry blends, cracked over pork and fish, or pickled whole.

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.description: Sweet, smoky or hot, the ground pepper of Spain and Hungary. Chorizo, potatoes, eggs and sour cream all take it.

ingredients.name: turmeric
ingredients.description: Earthy, bitter and golden, the colour of curry. Ginger, coconut milk and lentils are its daily company.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.description: Hot, bright and aromatic, fresh or dried. It threads through stir-fries, curries, marinades and baking alike.

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.description: Sweet, warm and woody. Apples and pastry in the west; lamb and rice in the Middle East; chocolate in Mexico.

ingredients.name: cardamom
ingredients.description: Floral, resinous and faintly citrusy. Coffee, rice puddings and pistachio pastries across the Middle East and India.

ingredients.name: clove
ingredients.description: Intensely aromatic, sweet and numbing. A few go into a glazed ham, a mulled wine or a rice pilaf.

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.description: Warm, sweet and slightly medicinal, best grated fresh. Spinach, cream sauces and custards depend on it.

ingredients.name: star anise
ingredients.description: Sweet, liquorice-like and penetrating. Chinese red braises, Vietnamese pho and poached pears.

ingredients.name: fennel seed
ingredients.description: Sweet and anise-flavoured, the seasoning of Italian sausage and Indian digestifs. Pork and fish love it.

ingredients.name: saffron
ingredients.description: Honeyed, hay-like and bitter, the most expensive spice there is. Rice, fish stews and Persian sweets.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.description: Pungent, woody heat that belongs on almost everything. Freshly cracked it also flatters strawberries and cheese.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.description: The seasoning that makes all others taste more like themselves. Flaky crystals to finish; fine salt to season from the start.

ingredients.name: caraway
ingredients.description: Earthy, anise-like and faintly bitter. Rye bread, cabbage, pork and Central European cooking.

ingredients.name: sumac
ingredients.description: Tart, fruity and crimson, a lemony dusting over salads, grills and flatbreads across the Levant.

ingredients.name: za'atar
ingredients.description: Thyme, sesame and sumac in one herby, tangy blend. Olive oil and flatbread are its first use.

ingredients.name: curry leaf
ingredients.description: Aromatic, nutty and citrusy, fried in oil at the start of a South Indian dish. Mustard seed and coconut go with it.

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.description: Citrusy, floral and fibrous, bruised and simmered into Thai and Vietnamese soups and curries. Ginger, chile and coconut milk complete it.

ingredients.name: chervil
ingredients.description: A delicate, anise-scented herb of French fines herbes. Eggs, fish and spring vegetables.

ingredients.name: marjoram
ingredients.description: Sweeter and gentler than oregano, a Mediterranean herb for mushrooms, lamb and tomato.

ingredients.name: juniper
ingredients.description: Piney, bitter and resinous, the flavour of gin. Game, cabbage and marinades.

photo.alt: Ripe juniper berries on a branch

ingredients.name: allspice
ingredients.description: Tastes like cinnamon, clove and nutmeg together. Jamaican jerk, Middle Eastern braises and pickles.

ingredients.name: lavender
ingredients.description: Floral, perfumed and a little bitter, used sparingly. Honey, lemon and shortbread.

ingredients.name: rose
ingredients.description: Perfumed, sweet and faintly astringent, as petals or water. Pistachio, cardamom and raspberry in Persian and Indian sweets.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.description: Mild, versatile and welcoming of almost any flavour. Lemon, garlic and thyme in Europe; ginger, soy and lemongrass in Asia.

ingredients.name: duck
ingredients.description: Rich, dark and fatty with a deep flavour. Orange, cherry, star anise and hoisin cut and complement it.

ingredients.name: turkey
ingredients.description: Lean, mild and large, the bird of feasts. Sage, cranberry and chestnut are its traditional company.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.description: Deep, savoury and iron-rich, from a quick-seared steak to a long braise. Red wine, mustard, mushrooms and black pepper.

ingredients.name: steak
ingredients.description: The prime cut, seared hard and rested. Butter, black pepper, blue cheese and red wine.

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.description: Sweet, rich and fatty, taking well to fruit and spice. Apple, fennel seed, sage and soy are all classic.

photo.alt: Raw pork chops with rosemary, garlic and tomato on a wooden board

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.description: Cured, smoked and salty, with fat that flavours everything it touches. Eggs, maple syrup and brussels sprouts.

ingredients.name: pancetta
ingredients.description: Italian cured pork belly, unsmoked and sweet. Carbonara, peas and beans.

ingredients.name: prosciutto
ingredients.description: Silky, salty dry-cured ham. Melon, figs, peaches and mozzarella.

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.description: Cooked and cured pork leg, mild and salty. Cheese, mustard, pineapple and eggs.

ingredients.name: sausage
ingredients.description: Seasoned ground pork in a casing, grilled or crumbled. Mustard, beans, cabbage and onions.

ingredients.name: chorizo
ingredients.description: Spanish paprika sausage with rendered red fat that seasons a whole pan. Chickpeas, potatoes, eggs and shellfish.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.description: Sweet, rich and grassy, the meat of the Mediterranean and Middle East. Rosemary, garlic, mint, cumin and yogurt.

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.description: Delicate, pale and tender. Lemon, butter, sage and marsala in Italian and French kitchens.

ingredients.name: rabbit
ingredients.description: Lean, mild and slightly sweet. Mustard, bacon, thyme and white wine.

ingredients.name: venison
ingredients.description: Lean, dark and gamey. Juniper, blackberries, red wine and chestnuts.

ingredients.name: liver
ingredients.description: Rich, mineral and faintly bitter, best cooked quickly. Onions, bacon, sage and brandy.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.description: Rich, mild and endlessly adaptable, from a soft poach to a meringue. Butter, cheese, bacon and chives.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.description: Mild bean curd that absorbs whatever surrounds it. Soy, ginger, sesame and chile.

ingredients.name: salmon
ingredients.description: Rich, oily and pink, raw or cooked. Dill, lemon, miso and soy.

ingredients.name: smoked salmon
ingredients.description: Silky, salty and smoky. Cream cheese, dill, capers and rye.

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.description: Meaty, deep-red fish, seared rare or raw. Soy, sesame, wasabi and avocado.

ingredients.name: cod
ingredients.description: Mild, flaky white fish. Butter, lemon, parsley and potatoes.

ingredients.name: sea bass
ingredients.description: Delicate, sweet white fish. Fennel, lemon, olive oil and herbs.

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.description: Sweet, snappy shellfish that cooks in minutes. Garlic, chile, lime and butter.

ingredients.name: scallop
ingredients.description: Sweet, tender shellfish seared hard. Brown butter, bacon and cauliflower.

ingredients.name: crab
ingredients.description: Sweet, delicate white meat. Lemon, mayonnaise, avocado and chile.

ingredients.name: lobster
ingredients.description: Rich, sweet shellfish. Butter, tarragon, champagne and corn.

ingredients.name: oyster
ingredients.description: Briny, mineral and alive. Lemon, shallot vinegar and champagne.

ingredients.name: mussels
ingredients.description: Sweet, briny shellfish steamed open. White wine, garlic, cream and parsley.

ingredients.name: clam
ingredients.description: Sweet, salty shellfish. Garlic, white wine, parsley and pasta.

ingredients.name: squid
ingredients.description: Mild, sweet and quick to toughen. Lemon, garlic, chile and olive oil.

ingredients.name: anchovy
ingredients.description: Intensely salty cured fish that melts into sauces. Garlic, olive oil, capers and lemon.

ingredients.name: mackerel
ingredients.description: Rich, oily and strongly flavoured. Mustard, horseradish, gooseberry and rhubarb.

ingredients.name: trout
ingredients.description: Delicate, sweet freshwater fish. Butter, almonds and dill.

ingredients.name: octopus
ingredients.description: Sweet, firm and meaty once tenderised. Paprika, potatoes, lemon and olive oil.

ingredients.name: caviar
ingredients.description: Salty, delicate fish roe. Blini, crème fraîche, egg and champagne.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.description: Rich, sweet and creamy, the fat of French cooking and baking. It carries herbs, browns to nuttiness and finishes sauces.

ingredients.name: brown butter
ingredients.description: Butter cooked until its solids toast, nutty and deep. Sage, hazelnut, cauliflower and fish.

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.description: Rich, smooth and sweet. Mushrooms, vanilla, strawberries and sauces of every kind.

ingredients.name: crème fraîche
ingredients.description: Cultured cream, tangy and rich. Smoked salmon, caviar, potatoes and fruit tarts.

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.description: Tangy cultured cream. Potatoes, paprika, dill and tacos.

ingredients.name: yogurt
ingredients.description: Tangy, cooling cultured milk. Cucumber, mint, honey and spiced meats.

ingredients.name: labneh
ingredients.description: Strained yogurt, thick and tangy. Olive oil, za'atar and flatbread.

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.description: Sweet, mild and nourishing. Custards, rice puddings and bread sauces.

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.description: Hard or melting cheese in general: salty, savoury and rich. Bread, apple and onion.

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.description: Hard, salty, crystalline cheese with deep umami. Pasta, risotto, asparagus and balsamic.

ingredients.name: pecorino
ingredients.description: Sharp, salty sheep's cheese. Black pepper, fava beans and honey.

ingredients.name: mozzarella
ingredients.description: Milky, mild fresh cheese. Tomato, basil and olive oil.

ingredients.name: burrata
ingredients.description: Mozzarella with a creamy heart. Tomatoes, peaches and prosciutto.

ingredients.name: ricotta
ingredients.description: Soft, sweet fresh cheese. Spinach, lemon, honey and pasta.

ingredients.name: mascarpone
ingredients.description: Rich, sweet cream cheese. Coffee, cocoa and berries.

ingredients.name: goat cheese
ingredients.description: Tangy, chalky and bright. Beet, honey, fig and thyme.

ingredients.name: feta
ingredients.description: Salty, crumbly brined cheese. Watermelon, tomato, cucumber and olives.

ingredients.name: halloumi
ingredients.description: Salty, squeaky cheese that grills without melting. Lemon, honey and mint.

ingredients.name: cheddar
ingredients.description: Sharp, nutty aged cheese. Apple, mustard, pickles and bread.

ingredients.name: gruyère
ingredients.description: Nutty, sweet alpine cheese that melts perfectly. Onion, potato, ham and white wine.

ingredients.name: blue cheese
ingredients.description: Salty, pungent and creamy. Pear, walnut, honey and celery.

ingredients.name: gorgonzola
ingredients.description: Creamy Italian blue. Pear, walnut, radicchio and polenta.

ingredients.name: brie
ingredients.description: Soft, buttery bloomy-rind cheese. Apple, grapes, honey and crusty bread.

ingredients.name: manchego
ingredients.description: Nutty Spanish sheep's cheese. Quince paste, almonds and olives.

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.description: Smooth, tangy and spreadable. Smoked salmon, chives, strawberries and cheesecake.

ingredients.name: paneer
ingredients.description: Firm, mild Indian fresh cheese. Spinach, peas and spice.

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.description: Crusty, chewy and sweet with fermentation. Butter, cheese, tomato and olive oil.

ingredients.name: pita
ingredients.description: Soft flatbread with a pocket. Hummus, labneh and grilled meats.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.description: Wheat and water or egg, in every shape. Parmesan, olive oil, garlic and tomato.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.description: Asian wheat, egg or rice noodles. Soy, sesame, ginger and broth.

ingredients.name: rice
ingredients.description: Mild, starchy grain. Soy and ginger, saffron and cardamom, coconut milk and chile.

ingredients.name: risotto rice
ingredients.description: Short, starchy rice stirred into creaminess. Parmesan, butter, white wine and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: polenta
ingredients.description: Cornmeal cooked soft or set and grilled. Butter, parmesan, gorgonzola and sausage.

ingredients.name: couscous
ingredients.description: Steamed semolina grains. Lamb, chickpeas, harissa and preserved lemon.

ingredients.name: bulgur
ingredients.description: Cracked wheat with a nutty bite. Parsley, tomato, lemon and lamb.

ingredients.name: oats
ingredients.description: Mild, creamy grain. Honey, cinnamon, apple and berries.

ingredients.name: chickpea
ingredients.description: Nutty, creamy pulse. Tahini, lemon, cumin and garlic.

ingredients.name: lentil
ingredients.description: Earthy pulse that cooks quickly. Cumin, turmeric, bacon and sausage.

ingredients.name: white bean
ingredients.description: Creamy white beans. Garlic, rosemary, tomato and sausage.

ingredients.name: black bean
ingredients.description: Earthy, dense Latin bean. Cumin, lime, cilantro and chile.

ingredients.name: almond
ingredients.description: Sweet, delicate nut. Apricot, cherry, honey and chocolate.

ingredients.name: hazelnut
ingredients.description: Sweet, toasty nut. Chocolate, coffee, pear and brown butter.

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.description: Rich, slightly bitter nut. Blue cheese, pear, honey and pomegranate.

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.description: Buttery, sweet nut. Maple, brown sugar, bourbon and sweet potato.

ingredients.name: pistachio
ingredients.description: Green, sweet, fragrant nut. Rose, cardamom, honey and orange.

ingredients.name: pine nut
ingredients.description: Soft, resinous nut. Basil, raisins, parmesan and chard.

ingredients.name: peanut
ingredients.description: Rich, savoury legume. Chile, lime, coconut and chocolate.

ingredients.name: cashew
ingredients.description: Sweet, buttery nut. Chicken, coconut and curry.

ingredients.name: chestnut
ingredients.description: Sweet, starchy nut of winter. Brussels sprouts, chocolate and game.

ingredients.name: sesame
ingredients.description: Nutty seeds and oil. Soy, ginger, honey and tahini.

ingredients.name: pumpkin seed
ingredients.description: Green, nutty seed. Chile, lime, squash and salsas.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.description: Fruity, peppery and bitter, the fat of the Mediterranean. Garlic, lemon, bread and tomato.

ingredients.name: olive
ingredients.description: Salty, bitter brined fruit. Lemon, fennel, anchovy and garlic.

ingredients.name: caper
ingredients.description: Salty, sour pickled buds. Lemon, anchovy, butter and fish.

ingredients.name: mustard
ingredients.description: Hot, sharp and tangy. Honey, vinegar, pork and cheese.

ingredients.name: horseradish
ingredients.description: Fierce, sinus-clearing root. Beef, cream, beet and smoked fish.

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.description: Sharp acidity for dressings and pickles. Olive oil, mustard and shallot.

ingredients.name: balsamic vinegar
ingredients.description: Sweet, syrupy aged vinegar. Strawberry, tomato, parmesan and radicchio.

ingredients.name: sherry vinegar
ingredients.description: Nutty, sharp Spanish vinegar. Olive oil, almonds and lentils.

ingredients.name: cider vinegar
ingredients.description: Fruity, mild apple vinegar. Pork, cabbage and honey.

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.description: Mild, sweet vinegar. Soy, ginger, sesame and cucumber.

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.description: Floral sweetness. Lemon, ginger, cheese and nuts.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.description: Pure sweetness. Butter, eggs, vanilla and fruit.

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.description: Sugar with molasses depth. Butter, cinnamon, banana and rum.

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.description: Caramel-like sweetness from the tree. Bacon, pecan, oats and sweet potato.

ingredients.name: molasses
ingredients.description: Dark, bitter-sweet syrup. Ginger, clove and beans.

ingredients.name: caramel
ingredients.description: Sugar cooked to amber. Salt, butter, cream and apple.

ingredients.name: chocolate
ingredients.description: Bitter, sweet and rich. Orange, raspberry, hazelnut and coffee.

ingredients.name: white chocolate
ingredients.description: Sweet, creamy cocoa butter. Raspberry, passion fruit and pistachio.

ingredients.name: cocoa
ingredients.description: Bitter, intense chocolate powder. Chile, cinnamon and coffee.

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.description: Sweet, floral and warm. Cream, custard, strawberries and chocolate.

ingredients.name: coffee
ingredients.description: Bitter, roasted and aromatic. Chocolate, cream, cardamom and hazelnut.

ingredients.name: tea
ingredients.description: Astringent, aromatic leaves. Milk, honey, mint and cardamom.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.description: Salty, fermented umami. Ginger, garlic, scallion and sesame.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.description: Pungent, salty fermented fish. Lime, chile, garlic and sugar.

ingredients.name: miso
ingredients.description: Salty, sweet fermented soybean paste. Butter, eggplant, salmon and sesame.

ingredients.name: tahini
ingredients.description: Nutty, bitter sesame paste. Lemon, garlic, chickpeas and honey.

ingredients.name: harissa
ingredients.description: Hot, smoky North African chile paste. Lamb, couscous, eggs and yogurt.

ingredients.name: pesto
ingredients.description: Basil, pine nut, garlic and parmesan pounded with oil. Pasta, tomato and potatoes.

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.description: Egg and oil emulsion, rich and tangy. Potato, crab, fries and tuna.

ingredients.name: hollandaise
ingredients.description: Butter and egg yolk sauce. Asparagus, eggs, salmon and steak.

ingredients.name: vinaigrette
ingredients.description: Oil, vinegar and mustard whisked together. Leaves, leeks, beans and potato.

ingredients.name: preserved lemon
ingredients.description: Salt-cured lemon, intense and floral. Chicken, olives and couscous.

ingredients.name: tamarind
ingredients.description: Sour, fruity pulp. Chile, sugar, fish sauce and dates.

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.description: Rich, sweet coconut cream. Lime, chile, lemongrass and turmeric.

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.description: Sweetened, thick milk. Coffee, lime, coconut and caramel.

ingredients.name: ghee
ingredients.description: Clarified butter with a nutty depth. Rice, lentils and spice tempering.

ingredients.name: truffle
ingredients.description: Earthy, musky fungus. Egg, butter, pasta and potato.

ingredients.name: pickles
ingredients.description: Sour, salty brined vegetables. Burgers, cheese and charcuterie.

ingredients.name: ketchup
ingredients.description: Sweet, tangy tomato sauce. Fries, burgers and eggs.

ingredients.name: hot sauce
ingredients.description: Vinegary chile heat. Eggs, chicken, mayonnaise and tacos.

ingredients.name: curry powder
ingredients.description: Warm, turmeric-yellow spice blend. Cauliflower, lentils, chicken and coconut milk.

ingredients.name: five-spice
ingredients.description: Star anise, cinnamon, clove, fennel and pepper. Pork, duck and hoisin.

ingredients.name: ras el hanout
ingredients.description: Moroccan spice blend of a dozen or more spices. Lamb, couscous and apricots.

ingredients.name: garam masala
ingredients.description: Warm North Indian finishing blend. Chicken, lamb, lentils and paneer.

ingredients.name: hoisin
ingredients.description: Sweet, salty fermented bean sauce. Duck, pork, scallion and cucumber.

ingredients.name: oyster sauce
ingredients.description: Thick, savoury-sweet sauce. Greens, beef, noodles and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: seaweed
ingredients.description: Briny, mineral sea vegetable. Rice, soy, miso and sesame.

ingredients.name: kimchi
ingredients.description: Spicy fermented cabbage. Pork, rice, tofu and eggs.

ingredients.name: wasabi
ingredients.description: Hot, green Japanese horseradish. Soy, tuna, salmon and avocado.

ingredients.name: orange blossom
ingredients.description: Heady floral water with a hint of bitter orange. Moroccan pastries, Middle Eastern puddings and Provençal cakes.

ingredients.name: elderflower
ingredients.description: Sweet, musky and floral, usually as cordial. Gooseberries, strawberries and sparkling wine.

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.description: Ground wheat, the base of bread and pastry. Butter, eggs, yeast and sugar.

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.description: Tannic, fruity and deep. Beef, lamb, mushrooms and pear.

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.description: Crisp, acidic and bright. Shellfish, chicken, shallot and butter.

ingredients.name: champagne
ingredients.description: Sparkling, dry and festive. Oysters, strawberries and caviar.

ingredients.name: sherry
ingredients.description: Nutty, dry to sweet fortified wine. Almonds, olives, ham and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: brandy
ingredients.description: Warm, grape spirit. Cream, pepper, liver and fruit.

ingredients.name: rum
ingredients.description: Sugar-cane spirit, light or dark. Lime, mint, banana and pineapple.

ingredients.name: gin
ingredients.description: Juniper spirit with botanicals. Tonic, lime, cucumber and elderflower.

ingredients.name: vodka
ingredients.description: Clean, neutral spirit. Tomato, cream, caviar and dill.

ingredients.name: tequila
ingredients.description: Agave spirit, earthy and bright. Lime, salt, chile and grapefruit.

ingredients.name: bourbon
ingredients.description: Sweet, oaky corn whiskey. Maple, pecan, peach and vanilla.

ingredients.name: whisky
ingredients.description: Smoky, oaky grain spirit. Honey, oats, chocolate and cheese.

ingredients.name: beer
ingredients.description: Bitter, malty and refreshing. Mussels, sausage, cheese and pretzels.

ingredients.name: cider
ingredients.description: Dry or sweet fermented apple. Pork, cabbage and cheddar.

ingredients.name: port
ingredients.description: Sweet, rich fortified wine. Blue cheese, figs, walnuts and venison.

ingredients.name: madeira
ingredients.description: Nutty, caramel fortified wine. Mushrooms, veal and zabaglione.

ingredients.name: amaretto
ingredients.description: Sweet almond liqueur. Cherry, peach and coffee.

ingredients.name: campari
ingredients.description: Bitter red aperitivo. Orange, grapefruit, gin and prosecco.

ingredients.name: pernod
ingredients.description: Anise liqueur. Fennel, shellfish and cream.

ingredients.name: kirsch
ingredients.description: Clear cherry brandy. Cherries, chocolate and fondue.

ingredients.name: sake
ingredients.description: Japanese rice wine. Soy, miso, ginger and fish.

ingredients.name: plum
ingredients.description: Sweet-sour and juicy, with skins that add tartness. Star anise, duck and cinnamon turn it savoury; almond makes it dessert.

ingredients.name: grape
ingredients.description: Sweet, juicy and refreshing, the table fruit of the cheese board. Roasted it goes with sausage and chicken.

ingredients.name: lychee
ingredients.description: Floral, sweet and juicy with a rose-like perfume. Coconut, lime and rose water flatter it.

ingredients.name: papaya
ingredients.description: Green it is crisp and neutral, the base of Thai som tam; ripe it is soft and sweet. Lime, chile and fish sauce either way.

ingredients.name: gooseberry
ingredients.description: Tart, green and bracing, cooked with sugar into fools and sauces. Elderflower and mackerel are the two classic matches.

ingredients.name: lime leaf
ingredients.description: Intensely citrusy leaves that perfume Thai curries and soups. Lemongrass and galangal complete the trio.

ingredients.name: galangal
ingredients.description: A peppery, pine-scented relative of ginger. The backbone of Thai tom yum and curry pastes.

ingredients.name: shiitake
ingredients.description: Meaty, smoky Asian mushroom. Soy, ginger, dashi and noodles.

ingredients.name: bok choy
ingredients.description: Mild, juicy Chinese greens. Garlic, ginger, oyster sauce and sesame.

ingredients.name: turnip
ingredients.description: Sweet, peppery root. Butter, duck, honey and miso.

ingredients.name: celeriac
ingredients.description: Nutty, celery-flavoured root. Mustard, apple, walnut and cream.

ingredients.name: chard
ingredients.description: Earthy green with a mineral stem. Garlic, pine nuts, raisins and ricotta.

ingredients.name: watercress
ingredients.description: Peppery, aquatic green. Egg, potato, orange and steak.

ingredients.name: endive
ingredients.description: Bitter, crisp chicory. Blue cheese, walnut, pear and ham.

ingredients.name: okra
ingredients.description: Grassy pod that thickens stews. Tomato, onion, cumin and lemon.

ingredients.name: tomatillo
ingredients.description: Tart green husked fruit. Chile, cilantro, lime and pork.

ingredients.name: fenugreek
ingredients.description: Bitter, maple-scented seeds and leaves. Indian curries, potatoes and spice blends.

ingredients.name: anise
ingredients.description: Sweet liquorice flavour in seed form. Breads, biscuits, fish and Mediterranean liqueurs.

ingredients.name: poppy seed
ingredients.description: Nutty, crunchy and faintly sweet. Lemon cakes, bagels and Central European pastries.

ingredients.name: morel
ingredients.description: Honeycombed wild mushroom with a nutty, earthy flavour. Cream, asparagus, eggs and madeira.

ingredients.name: sole
ingredients.description: Delicate, sweet flatfish. Brown butter, lemon, capers and parsley.

ingredients.name: monkfish
ingredients.description: Firm, meaty white fish. Bacon, saffron, rosemary and garlic.

ingredients.name: herring
ingredients.description: Oily, rich fish, usually pickled or smoked. Vinegar, onion, dill and sour cream.

ingredients.name: goose
ingredients.description: Rich, dark and very fatty. Apple, sauerkraut, chestnuts and juniper.

ingredients.name: pheasant
ingredients.description: Lean game bird with a mild, slightly gamey flavour. Bacon, chestnuts, cabbage and red wine.

ingredients.name: quail
ingredients.description: Tiny, delicate game birds. Grapes, pomegranate and sumac.

ingredients.name: foie gras
ingredients.description: Rich, buttery fattened liver. Figs, Sauternes and brioche.

ingredients.name: goat
ingredients.description: Lean and gamey, loved in Caribbean, Mexican and Greek cooking. Chile, cumin, allspice and lime.

ingredients.name: guanciale
ingredients.description: Cured pork jowl, the fat of Roman pasta. Eggs, pecorino and black pepper.

ingredients.name: mortadella
ingredients.description: Smooth, pistachio-studded Bolognese sausage. Focaccia, burrata and lemon.

ingredients.name: merguez
ingredients.description: Spiced North African lamb sausage, red with harissa. Couscous and chickpeas.

ingredients.name: sauerkraut
ingredients.description: Sour fermented cabbage. Pork, sausage, juniper and rye.

ingredients.name: tortilla
ingredients.description: Corn or wheat flatbread of Mexico. Lime, cilantro, beans and chile.

ingredients.name: pastry
ingredients.description: Butter and flour, flaky or short. Apples, custard, cheese and leeks.

ingredients.name: meringue
ingredients.description: Whipped egg white and sugar, crisp or soft. Cream, lemon, berries and passion fruit.

ingredients.name: custard
ingredients.description: Sweet egg and cream, as a sauce or set. Vanilla, rhubarb and pastry.

ingredients.name: ice cream
ingredients.description: Frozen sweet cream. Chocolate, caramel, fruit and olive oil.

ingredients.name: shortbread
ingredients.description: Buttery, crumbly biscuit. Tea, lemon, jam and whisky.

ingredients.name: cotija
ingredients.description: Salty, crumbly Mexican cheese. Corn, lime, chile and beans.

ingredients.name: fish
ingredients.description: White fish in general: mild, flaky and delicate. Lemon, butter, parsley and capers.

edges: Anise sweetness against bright citrus; the classic Sicilian winter salad.
Good oil rounds fennel's rawness; shaved thin it needs almost nothing else.
Salty olives give the crisp, sweet bulb something to push against.
Garlic warms fennel when it is braised or roasted.
Salt and umami for the sweet bulb; shave both thin.
Fennel braised under a roast chicken turns silky and sweet.
A little heat sharpens fennel's sweetness.
Mint lifts raw fennel; both are cooling.
Anise on anise: the liqueur deepens the bulb's own flavour.
The sweetest summer tomato wants the peppery, clove-like herb.
Fresh acid against milky fat; the Caprese pairing.
Earthy sweetness against tangy, chalky cheese.
Sour and hot together are the base of most Mexican and Thai cooking.
Spring sweetness with a cooling herb, a British kitchen staple.
Bitter cocoa and sweet citrus oil, a pairing found in every pastry tradition.
Bitter-salty against sweet-sour, the backbone of the Sicilian salad.
Sweet-tart fruit cuts the richness of the fat; sauce or roast, it works.
Sweet, soft fruit against salty, pungent cheese.
Dark fruit with a sour edge against rich, fatty meat.
A few drops of aged vinegar make strawberries taste more of themselves.
Juicy sweetness against briny, crumbly cheese.
The herb's cool sweetness balances the meat's gamey fat.
The anise-grass note of dill cuts the fish's oiliness.
Sweet shellfish wrapped in smoky, salty fat.
